title: The proper-image reduction tower of open extension equals the compact-support tower
statement: Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes, $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism, and $c=(X\xrightarrow j V\xrightarrow p Y)$ a compactification [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Assume $j$ is quasi-compact. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A$, a uniformizer $t$ and $P_n=A/t^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale sites put $R_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$, and let $\operatorname{Res}_n$ be restriction along $R_W\to(P_n)_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars]. Let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete], put $L=j_!K$ using completed ringed extension by zero [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed], and let $K_n,L_n$ be their derived finite reductions [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Let $\alpha_n:L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!K_n$ be the evaluated canonical comparison of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Set $N_n=\operatorname{Res}_n Rp_{*,n}L_n$ and $M_n=\operatorname{Res}_n Rf^c_{!,n}K_n$, where $Rp_{*,n}$ is the ordinary finite-coefficient derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and $Rf^c_{!,n}=Rp_{*,n}j_!$ is the same finite composite as in [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. Put $S_n=\operatorname{Res}^{P_{n+1}}_{P_n}$, let $d_n:L_{n+1}\to S_nL_n$ be the quotient reduction, and let $C_n(H):Rp_{*,n+1}S_nH\xrightarrow{\sim}S_nRp_{*,n}H$ be [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. Equip $N_\bullet$ with the transitions $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}(C_n(L_n)\circ Rp_{*,n+1}(d_n))$, and equip $M_\bullet$ with the transitions obtained by applying $Rf^c_{!,n+1}$ to $K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}^{P_{n+1}}_{P_n}K_n$ and then the comparison of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars], followed by restriction to $R_Y$. Then $\beta_n=\operatorname{Res}_n Rp_{*,n}(\alpha_n):N_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$ is an isomorphism of inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system]: $\beta_n t^N_n=t^M_n\beta_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq1$. No constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypothesis on $K$ is required.

proof.text: Map invertibility of the prime from the base field to global sections of Y, then V and X, and finally to every stalk. Apply [lem-trf-compact-support-system-evaluation-coherence] and extract its ordinary identity-on-sections coefficient comparison, K-injective instances and derived-resolution normalization as DirectData. Apply [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison] to the quasi-compact open j with the resulting global invertibility assumptions, obtaining the normalized reduction calculi, open operations, tensor comparison and strict comparison r.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-quotient-square] to these data. Its ordinary comparison and generator normalization give OpenData. Its reduction square says d_L composed with scalar restriction of alpha_n equals alpha_(n+1), followed by j_! of d_K and the derived open restriction comparison. Apply the finite derived direct image to this equality. Naturality of DirectData.comparison moves scalar restriction of Rp_*(alpha_n) across the direct-image comparison. Then naturality of compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp and preservation of composition by completed scalar restriction give precisely properTransition_n followed by beta_n = beta_(n+1) followed by supportTransition_n.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib NatTrans.ofOpSequence to the components beta_n.hom and the consecutive transition equality. Each component is invertible, so NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app makes this natural transformation invertible. Its associated isomorphism has the specified components by reflexivity. This proves the unchanged tower statement, including all longer naturality equations.
